input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The ownership provisions meet our preferred position. Section 14.1 confirms Customer retains all Customer Data, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP, with only a limited processing right to Vendor (no assignment of our IP or data). Section 14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable with an express present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurance cooperation. Section 14.3 leaves Vendor with its pre-existing Vendor Technology only (definition 1.9 expressly excludes Customer Data and pre-existing Customer IP) and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the Section 13.2 licence, which is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, and includes modification, derivative works and contractor support for Customer's business. Section 14.4 rules out joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument and keeps feedback voluntary with Customer retaining unrestricted use of its own feedback. Section 15.1 further bars sale, advertising use, commingling and model training on Customer Data without our consent. Minor note only: the "improve the Services" purpose in 14.1 and the telemetry carve-out in the Customer Data definition are narrow and adequately fenced by 15.1, so no redline is warranted.
